question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a red present, Bob has a black present, Claire has a white present, Dave has a pink present, Eve has a gold present, Fred has a brown present, and Gertrude has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) red present
(B) black present
(C) white present
(D) pink present
(E) gold present
(F) brown present
(G) teal present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: red, black, white, pink, gold, brown, teal
1. Claire ↔ Gertrude: red, black, teal, pink, gold, brown, white
2. Claire ↔ Eve: red, black, gold, pink, teal, brown, white
3. Bob ↔ Gertrude: red, white, gold, pink, teal, brown, black
4. Claire ↔ Alice: gold, white, red, pink, teal, brown, black
5. Eve ↔ Alice: teal, white, red, pink, gold, brown, black
6. Claire ↔ Bob: teal, red, white, pink, gold, brown, black
7. Claire ↔ Alice: white, red, teal, pink, gold, brown, black
Alice has the white present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
